I will put fertilizer on this rice plot, but not too much. Last season I used a small amount and saw better tillering where the field held water well, so this season I will use improved seed again and top up with urea because I own this land and rice is worth spending on when the rains are fair in Mwanza. I will not carry much manure there because that work is heavy, and I will use some herbicide and hire labor at transplanting and weeding time because my total land is big and family labor alone is not enough.
